notes.title: Update V2.0.3
notes.content:
Huge thanks for all the support as always, I am working on trying to make the current game the best it can be before starting on the main roadmap.



Below are the full update notes:

Sparks fix for landing after jumps in Koi Speedpark

Zoom selection now saves/loads when needed

Custom controls now save

Player can no longer turn while jumping

Exhaust smoke added

Paint bucket now shows correctly when unlocked in the Unlockable menu

Add new effects and debris into the Power races

Bug fix for red car stopping randomly

Increased speed of missiles

Bug fix for CPU1 yellow on Monzarella

Trees can be destroyed with rockets at Monzarella

More item pads added to all tracks for Power Racing mode



More updates coming soon ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: Demo update V2.02
notes.content:
Thanks for all the great feedback so far, I have ironed out some bugs and added improvements.



Full list of changes below:

Fix for 1st place when 5th

Tweening added

Funky 3D backdrops added

Much improved car select screen

If game is set to controller, but player presses a keyboard key it will now revert to keyboard controls

When using keyboard A and D now steers left and right as well as the arrow keys

If player sets accel to W key this will automatically set proceed button on menus to Enter

If player sets brake to S key this will set back button on menus to Esc

Player can now select Up Arrow for accel and Down for Brake, menus will change to Enter and Esc if this happens

Oil slick fix for Koi Speedpark
